steps.title: Inspect the connection card
steps.body: Read the endpoint and API key fields for xAI. Enter credentials only in the provider's protected key field if you intend to configure it. Use Test connection deliberately and read its result. Reachability and authentication do not establish that a chosen chat model can produce a reply.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Read failures as auth or network
steps.body: A failed test often reflects an invalid or expired key; trailing whitespace is also common. If the key is clean but the test still fails, the upstream service may be unreachable. Separate auth errors from network errors before changing model settings.

steps.title: Pick a Grok model from the selector
steps.body: After a successful test, open the model selector and choose the Grok model you intend to use. The list reflects your xAI account entitlements, so an empty list points back to the connection card. Saving a model without a working key leaves the provider unusable.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Change models without changing keys
steps.body: Switching the model in the selector leaves the stored API key intact. Re-test only if the connection card still shows an error. Model choice affects cost and speed more than reliability; choose the smallest model that fits your task before moving to Generation tuning.

steps.title: Compare generation controls individually
steps.body: Read the sampling and output-limit controls. Sampling changes variation; output limits bound response length. Note the previous value before adjusting one setting. A useful comparison needs the same prompt and model later; if an edit makes results worse, restore that value rather than changing several controls together.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Read generation errors before retuning
steps.body: If a later generation fails, read its error and compare connection, model access and response limits before changing sampling controls. Test connection can help distinguish a connection problem from a rejected model request. Retrying without understanding the error can repeat the same failure.
